content: Mw'ezoola siku, oluganjo lw'abemeezi lwaliiri lwayushuuka. aBayaahudi baliiri kuderha olulimi lw'eKigiriki barhondera kulundumira aBayaahudi baliiri kuderha olulimi lw'eGiheburaniya, bulaala abashumbakazi baabo baali babonereerwe egihe ch'okugaba ebiryo ngasi lusiku.
Zilaala ntumwa ekumi n'ebiri zagusha abemeezi booshi, zanababwira ntya: «Birhakwaneene rhulekeerere kuyigiriza eChinwa cha Nnamahanga mpu rhubeere rhuli rhwagaba ebiryo.
Cho girhumire, beene beerhu, mushonde ahagarhi kenyu bantu mushanvu bahamiriizwe bwinja n'abantu, bayunjwire Muuka-Mutagatiifu n'obwenge bunene. Boowe, barhwaheereza akoola kaasi.
Ntyo neerhu, rhwakomeza gusaliira n'okuyigiriza eChinwa cha Nnamahanga.»

Abemeezi booshi bali chigushire ahoola basiima eyoola myaazi. Bachishoga Sitefaano, muntu w'obwemeezi bunene onayunjwire Muuka-Mutagatiifu, Firipo, Porokoro, Nikanori, Timooni, Parimena na Nikola w'eAntiyokiya wayemeeraga edini ly'eKiyaahudi.
Bamoleka bo eNtumwa, nazo zabasaliirira eyi zibalambuliire kw'amaboko.
Echinwa cha Nnamahanga chaliiri kuyaalagala omu bantu, oluganjo lw'abemeezi lwaliiri kuyushuuka bweneene eYerusaleema, n'echigusho chinene ch'abadaahwa chayemeera Yeesu.
Sitefaano aliyunjwire emigisho n'obuhashe bunene. Byaarhuma agenda ajira ebigiriginjo n'ebimenyeeso binene omu lubaga.

Aliko bantu baguma, barhondera obuhaka na Sitefaano. Abo bantu bahulikiraga omu sinagoogi ederhwa y'«aBantu Barhengaga omu Buja», barhengaga omu gishagala ch'eKureene n'eche Alegizanduriya. Abandi bahulukiraga omu gihugo ch'eKilikiya n'eche Aziya.
Aliko barhagalaga guhima Sitefaano kwenge aligwerhe bwenge bunene, na Muuka-Mutagatiifu aliiri kumuha ebinwa by'okuderha.
Baaja baaha abantu efuranga yi baderha oku: «Rhwamuyunvaga ali aderha ebinwa by'okudukanga Muusa na Nnamahanga.»
Bararusa olubaga n'abashamuka b'aBayaahudi haguma n'abigiriza b'amarhegeko. Bayegeera Sitefaano, bamurhoola, banamuheeka omu kabuga k'aBayaahudi.
Baleerha abahamiiriza b'obubeeshi baliiri baderha ntya: «Oyu muntu arhali aleka kuderha ebinwa bibi elugulu w'eNju ntagatiifu ya Nnamahanga n'eRhegeko lya Muusa.
Kwenge rhwamuyunvaga aderha oku Yeesu w'eNazareeti ashanda eyi Nju ya Nnamahanga, anahindamula n'emicho Muusa arhulekeraga.»
Abantu booshi baliiri mw'akoola kabuga k'aBayaahudi babeere bali baheneereza Sitefaano, baava baabona amalanga maage makola mashushire nk'ama malahika.
